title: Binding to the DNA Minor Groove by Heterocyclic Dications: from AT Specific to GC Recognition Compounds.
authors: Paul, Ananya; Nanjunda, Rupesh; Wilson, W David
one_liner_zh: 综述小分子杂环二脒类化合物与DNA小沟结合识别，虽涉及DNA分子识别但对象为小分子而非蛋白质，方法上无AI或物理模拟，仅对TF-DNA研究有间接启发。
abstract: Compounds that bind in the DNA minor groove have provided critical information on DNA molecular recognition, have found extensive uses in biotechnology, and are providing clinically useful drugs against diseases as diverse as cancer and sleeping sickness. This review focuses on the development of clinically useful heterocyclic diamidine minor groove binders. These compounds show that the classical model for minor groove binding in AT DNA sequences must be expanded in several ways: compounds with nonstandard shapes can bind strongly to the groove, water can be directly incorporated into the minor groove complex in an interfacial interaction, compounds can be designed to recognize GC and mixed AT/GC base pair sequences, and stacked dimers can form to recognize specific sequences. abstract_zh: 结合DNA小沟的化合物为DNA分子识别提供了关键信息，在生物技术领域有广泛应用，并且正在成为治疗癌症和昏睡病等多种疾病的临床有效药物。本综述聚焦于临床上有用的杂环二脒类小沟结合剂的发展。这些化合物表明，经典的AT DNA序列小沟结合模型必须在多个方面进行扩展：具有非标准形状的化合物能强效结合于小沟，水分子可通过界面相互作用直接整合进小沟复合物中，可设计化合物以识别GC及混合AT/GC碱基对序列，并且堆叠的二聚体可形成以识别特定序列。(c) 2023 Wiley Periodicals LLC.
